provenance.sourceName: Fair-Rite 95 material data sheet, 95 Material Hysteresis Loop (25 and 100 C)
provenance.verificationMethod: Remanence at 100 C read where the 100 C loop's descending branch crosses H = 0: about 750-800 gauss, 0.08 T (the record held 0.8 T, above the 0.39 T saturation at 100 C; the 25 C loop gives about 1000 gauss, as the record's 0.102 T). Read by eye from the plotted curve, not digitised.

provenance.sourceName: Fair-Rite Products Corp. - Reference Tables (Ferrite Material Constants)
provenance.verificationMethod: Section 'FERRITE MATERIAL CONSTANTS' (page modified 2026-01-21). Source scope: 'typical for Fair-Rite MnZn and NiZn ferrites' (MgZn grade 46 NOT covered by the stated scope). As printed: Specific Heat : 0.25 cal/g/°C -> 1046 J/(kg·K) (thermochemical cal 4.184 J; 1046.7 with IT cal 4.1868); Thermal Conductivity : 35 – 43 mW/cm – °C -> 3.5-4.3 W/(m·K). Note: Fair-Rite engineering-kit pages (e.g. https://fair-rite.com/product/engineering-kits-199000005/) reportedly print '3.5 - 4.5 mW/cm-°C' - a factor-10 inconsistency (and 4.5 vs 4.3) with the reference table; the Reference Tables page is the canonical one. Material 46 is MgZn and outside the stated 'MnZn and NiZn' scope -> left out.
